name: sing-box Link Manager
description:
Connect to a sing-box server straight from Quick Settings: import connections from a share link, a subscription URL, or a QR code image, then pick a server from the menu. Subscriptions are cached, so connecting never waits on the network.

The extension never spawns processes. The sing-box backend runs as a systemd user service (singbox-ext.service) that the install script in the project sets up together with the permissions sing-box needs to create a TUN device; the extension only starts and stops that service over D-Bus. Run that script once before connecting - see the project page.
